description: A React component named FileUploader that provides a user interface to select a CSV or JSON file, reads its content as text, and passes metadata and content to a callback function.

methods.name: FileUploader({ onUpload })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a file upload interface, handles file selection, reads file content, and invokes a callback with metadata and content.

calls: onUpload && onUpload({ name: file.name, size: file.size, type: file.type, content: text })
